items.description: Bab Sharqi is one of the eight ancient city gates of Damascus, known as the Gate of the East. It is the only gate that remains largely intact from the Roman era.
facts: Original name was Gate of the Sun
Located in the Old City of Damascus

items.description: Lake Muzairib is a natural freshwater lake located in the Daraa Governorate of southwestern Syria. It is a popular destination for locals due to its scenic beauty.
Slenfeh is a mountain resort area in the Latakia Governorate, famous for its lush forests and cool climate. It sits high in the Coastal Mountain Range.
facts: Located in the Coastal Mountain Range
Famous for pine and cedar trees

items.description: Jabal al-Shumariyah is a mountain peak located in the Syrian Desert, east of Homs. It is part of the Jabal al-Shumariyah range which rises above the surrounding plateau.
